Assistant ProfessorB.Com (NMKRV College for Women), M.Com (Bangalore University), KSET Linkedin Link Ms. Lavanya B.K. is an Assistant Professor with 9 years of experience in academia. A KSET-qualified Ph.D. candidate at Jain University, she has completed her coursework and actively engages in teaching and research. With a strong academic foundation in commerce, she brings enthusiasm and dedication to the classroom and research forum. Her areas of interest include developing innovative methodologies in accounting and taxation and contributing meaningfully to academic development through publications and conference participation. Specialisations and Interests Accounting, Taxation Papers Presented at Conferences The Influence of Social Media on Consumer Perception of Circular Economy Business Model, presented at an international conference at Jain University on 3 December 2024. A Comprehensive Study on the Role of Women Entrepreneurs in the Contemporary Scenario – Challenges and Opportunities, presented and published at an international conference held at Carmel Convent College on 24 June 2024.
